# Anchored carrier with a closed first slot

An invariant unary input binds the method's sole Object formal. The binary
result retains a fixed Object first slot and that formal in its second slot;
closed contexts and a covariant producer retain their original order.
Frozen observers supplied outside the DEX check partial state, exact failures,
deferred callbacks, opaque cached results, nulls and late checked reads.
Source and imported-declaration routes preserve all original entries,
Signatures and Exceptions and reject Signature-only and compiled controls.
